column2: where there is a surviving spouse —

(i)
who is not a beneficiary or contributor to any
other pension scheme or benefit scheme, such
spouse shall be entitled to receive the monthly
benefits  in  the  same  manner  the  deceased
contributor would have received the same had
he lived till he reaches eighty years of age;

(ii)
who is a beneficiary or  contributor to any other
pension scheme or benefit scheme, such spouse
shall  be  entitled  to  receive  such  amount  of
contributions as remain unpaid out of the total
amount of contributions, together with interest
thereon as determined by the Board taking into
consideration  the  banking  rates  prevailing  at
the relevant time; and
where there is no surviving spouse—

(i)
if there is a child under twenty- one years of
age, such child; or
